jobs.description: The City of Chicago's Department of Aviation is seeking an Airport Regulatory Compliance Manager in Chicago, IL to oversee inspections, audits, and investigations of airport security programs, ensuring compliance with TSA regulations, 49 CFR parts, and state requirements.
